help.title: Tonight TV Guide
help.description: A quick walkthrough of the admin workspace, viewer experience, and shortcuts.

welcome.title: Welcome to Tonight TV
welcome.subtitle: Private, synchronized watch rooms for you and your friends.
welcome.intro: Tonight TV is a private watch room. The owner creates a room, shares the link, and everyone inside sees and hears the same playback at the same moment. There are no public feeds, no algorithms, and no ads — just the link.
remember: Rooms are private — only people with the link can join.
Playback is synchronized — pause, play, or seek and everyone follows.
Subtitles and chat stay inside the room and disappear when it ends.

steps.title: Sign in as the admin
steps.body: Use your admin email to land in the Your Rooms workspace.

steps.title: Create a room
steps.body: Give it a friendly name, then copy the share link for your friends.

steps.title: Watch together
steps.body: Drop a media item, press play, and enjoy the show in sync.

admin.title: Owning a room
admin.subtitle: Create, share, and control your private room as the admin.
admin.intro: As the admin you control the room. The Your Rooms workspace is where you keep track of every room you own and decide which one is open tonight.
admin.lifecycleBody: A room is either Active or Deactivated. Deactivating hides it from the public preview so nobody can join with the link — you can reactivate it any time.
admin.privateBody: Only people who received the link can join. We never share or recommend rooms.

steps.title: Manage from the workspace
steps.body: Open the action menu on any room card to rename, share, deactivate, reactivate, or delete it.

steps.title: Drop media in
steps.body: Inside the room, use Add Media to paste a direct URL, a YouTube ID, or a torrent.

steps.title: Drive playback
steps.body: Play, pause, seek, and play next are shared with every viewer the moment you press them.

join.subtitle: What to expect when a friend shares a link with you.
join.intro: A friend shared a link? Open it, pick a nickname, and join. You don’t need an account to watch — Tonight TV creates a private anonymous identity for the session.
join.privacyBody: Nicknames stay in the room. Account info never leaves your device.

faq.title: Common questions
faq.subtitle: Quick answers about privacy, syncing, and what to do when something feels off.

items.q: Why is playback lagging behind the room?
items.a: A small lag (under a second) is normal while everyone stabilizes. If the gap grows beyond a few seconds, the room is reconnecting — your screen will resync on its own.

items.q: Can I reactivate a room I deactivated?
items.a: Yes. The action menu on each room card lets you deactivate and reactivate at any time. Deactivated rooms are hidden from the public preview but stay in your workspace.

items.q: What happens when I delete a room?
items.a: Deleting is permanent. The room, its media, subtitles, chat history, and any membership are removed. This is irreversible, so we ask you to confirm.
No. Viewers get an anonymous identity tied to the room session. They only need a nickname and the link you shared.
Yes. Use the Up Next panel to add as many items as you like. Use the move, play-now, and delete actions to keep the queue tidy.
Subtitles are private to the room. Owners can upload SRT or VTT files; viewers can opt in to whichever track they prefer.

items.q: What if the video won't play?
items.a: Tonight TV surfaces the specific reason (autoplay permission, expired URL, DRM, etc.). Replace the source and try again, or pick a different file.

items.q: How is the room timeline kept in sync?
items.a: Every command (play, pause, seek, select) goes through a single versioned state in the database. Viewers drift toward the latest version with sub-second corrections.

items.q: What if a viewer drops out and rejoins?
items.a: They will be re-synced to the current room state on rejoin. Chat history they can see is loaded up to the most recent 100 messages.

items.q: What about movies, shows, and clips?
items.a: Tonight TV is source-agnostic. Drop in a direct MP4/HLS URL, a YouTube Video ID, or a torrent and the room plays it.

items.q: Why is the link the only invite?
items.a: There are no usernames, no friend graphs, no invites. If you have the link you can join — the room is yours to share or not.

items.q: Does the room owner see everything?
items.a: Owners see chat and presence. Subtitle tracks are private to the uploader and whichever viewers opt in to load them.
